facts.fact: Wavemaker's MCP access is available on its Pro plan, which the page lists at $99 per month.
facts.quote: MCP access is available on the Pro plan ($99/mo) and up.

facts.fact: Wavemaker lets new users create a first video free on the web, with 75 credits to start.
facts.quote: create your first video free on the web (75 credits to start)

facts.fact: Per the page, a video of about 60 seconds costs 150 Wavemaker credits.
facts.quote: For reference, a ~60-second video runs 150 credits, and a 1080p export adds 10.

facts.fact: Per the page, a refine operation on an existing Wavemaker video costs 15 credits.
The Wavemaker MCP server exposes 13 tools in total.
The Wavemaker MCP server is hosted at the URL https://wavemaker.adwave.com/mcp.
The Wavemaker MCP server authenticates clients with OAuth 2.1 using PKCE.
facts.quote: It uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE for authentication

facts.fact: The MCP (Model Context Protocol) is described on the page as an open standard for connecting AI assistants to external tools and data.
facts.quote: MCP stands for Model Context Protocol, an open standard for connecting AI assistants to external tools and data.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's get_cost_estimate MCP tool returns the credit cost for a given video length or export resolution before any credits are spent.
facts.quote: Returns the credit cost for a given video length or export resolution before you commit.

facts.fact: Adwave says a finished Wavemaker video can run as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks starting from $50, plus Google, YouTube, Meta, Reddit, and display.
facts.quote: Through Adwave, that same video can run as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks, from $50, plus Google, YouTube, Meta, Reddit, and display.

facts.fact: Adwave says the Wavemaker MCP server exposes 13 tools and has working OAuth.
facts.quote: Wavemaker shipped a working 13-tool server with real OAuth, callable today.

facts.fact: Adwave says MCP access requires the Pro plan at $99 per month or higher.
facts.quote: MCP access is available on the Pro plan ($99/mo) and above.

facts.fact: Adwave says the free plan includes 75 credits to start for creating a first video on the web.
facts.quote: The free plan lets you create your first video on the web (75 credits to start)

facts.fact: Wavemaker's MCP server authenticates with OAuth 2.1 using PKCE, so users do not paste API keys into config files.
facts.quote: Wavemaker's MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE.

facts.fact: The Wavemaker MCP server's get_cost_estimate tool returns the credit cost for a given video length and resolution before generation.
facts.quote: The `get_cost_estimate` tool lets the assistant tell you the credit cost for a given length and resolution before generating.

facts.fact: The Wavemaker MCP server endpoint is https://wavemaker.adwave.com/mcp.
facts.quote: Point your MCP client at `https://wavemaker.adwave.com/mcp`, complete the OAuth login
